newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-CULLINAN CENTURY EARNS DRAW FOR SOUTH AFRICA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CULLINAN CENTURY EARNS DRAW FOR SOUTH AFRICA.

text.p: A brilliant unbeaten century from Daryll Cullinan together with a timely intervention from the weather enabled South Africa to escape with a draw in the final test against India at the Wanderers on Monday.

Cullinan finished on 122 not out from 194 balls with 15 fours and a six in South Africa's second innings 228 for eight. He received invaluable support from all-rounder Lance Klusener who scored 49 in an eighth-wicket partnership of 127.
Cullinan's third test century saved his team after they had looked on the verge defeat after being set 356 to win.
South Africa collapsed to 76 for five before a violent rainstorm sent the teams back to the pavilion for three hours and when they re-emerged it was quickly 95 for seven.
But in a nail-biting last hour Cullinan and Klusener did enough to secure a draw and leave South Africa 2-0 winners in the three-test series.
Spinner Anil Kumble finished with three for 40 while pacemen Javagal Srinath and Venkatesh Prasad took two wickets apiece.
